events.title: MOTH | Monica Usher
events.description: In this exhibition, Monica Usher returns to a favourite subject, the Moth. The moth lends a whimsical narrative through which she tries to convey a sense of wonder about the world around her, inviting the viewer into realms where every living thing is sacred and anything is possible. events.title: FOLDED MEMORIES | Group Exhibition
events.description: A group exhibition of mixed visuals arts including new paintings by Sam Suttie, sculpture by Nettie Sumner and a selection of new ceramic vessels by Monica Usher and Clairy Laurence. Coming together as a celebration of fragments of remembrance, inspired by a swarm of moths that left remnants in a Toowoomba garden. Presented alongside oil paintings by Monica Usher in Gallery 1. events.title: THIRTEEN: LUCKY FOR SOME | Group Exhibition
events.description: THIRTEEN: LUCKY FOR SOME brings together six talented and skilful artists of various experience in the visual arts industry. The common through line is their unwavering dedication to the arts. The artists include Sarah Sculley, Clay Smith, Michaela Coggins, Peter Breen, Nikki Logan and Ricardo Lawyer.
